headline: Proposed ordinance to protect private significant trees during construction, and a Mayor's request to amend city code.
summary: Councilor Sait filed the tree ordinance, which would change Section 12-111.1 of the Code of Ordinances. The Mayor's request covers Chapter 15, Article III of the same code.
items: Mayor's request to amend Chapter 15, Article III of the Code of Ordinances
